title: HAI drift
description: The latest drift check of each HAI type, pushed by the drift check phase.

panels.title: Share of drifted features, by HAI type
panels.description: The share that decides the trigger.

targets.expr: max by (hai_type) (hai_drift_share and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Features that drifted, by HAI type

targets.expr: max by (hai_type) (hai_drift_features_drifted and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Trigger flag, by HAI type
panels.description: 1 when the check reached its trigger share.

targets.expr: max by (hai_type) (hai_drift_triggered and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))

max by (hai_type) (hai_drift_current_rows and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Status of the latest check, by HAI type
panels.description: Checked or skipped, with the skip reason in the drift record.

targets.expr: max by (hai_type, status) (hai_drift_status and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Seconds since the last drift check
panels.description: From the finish time of the check phase.

panels.title: HAI types with no Production baseline
panels.description: Empty while every type has a Production model.

targets.expr: max by (hai_type) (hai_drift_unmonitored and on (job, phase, model_set, job_type, outcome) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds == on (job, phase, model_set, job_type) group_left () max by (job, phase, model_set, job_type) (hai_job_finish_timestamp_seconds)))
